transforms.name: adapter-step-0
transforms.effect: cumulativeTokens is total.totalTokens when it is a non-negative safe integer. The usage upsert is live phase only, and a duplicate counter is not upserted again.

transforms.name: adapter-step-1
transforms.effect: Bootstrap phase stores a counter when usageStartsAtZero but does not emit the usage update. The monitor test shows bootstrap history is not burned.

transforms.name: adapter-step-2
transforms.effect: pricing is attached when the counter total is > 0 or a previous counter exists. The first sample is gap baseline. A decreasing total is gap counter-reset. A model change is gap model-change. Incomplete or inconsistent buckets are gap incomplete-buckets.

transforms.name: adapter-step-3
transforms.effect: A complete interval sets inputTokens to input minus cached, cacheReadTokens to cached, cacheCreationTokens to the literal 0, and outputTokens to the output delta. contextTokens is the input delta only when it equals the last request.

transforms.name: adapter-step-4
transforms.effect: The usage value sets boundary sample and canonical false. It does not set totalTokens, deltaTokens, or costUsd.
